name: A New Plague
summary: In Brill, Apothecary Johaan gathers scales from the Vile Fin murlocs along Tirisfal's coast. The errand supports the Royal Apothecary Society's work on a contagion meant to spread beyond isolated victims and reach larger populations.

sections.title: Scaling Up the Contagion
sections.body: Apothecary Johaan's research in Brill needs more than a poison that harms one target. He is working on a disease that can spread on its own and endure in the wild. For those studies, he looks to the shoreline wildlife of Tirisfal Glades. The resilient biology of the coastal Vile Fin murlocs offers promising material for his work.

sections.title: The Vile Fin Reagents
sections.body: Aggressive Vile Fin murloc tribes trouble the northern and western shores of Tirisfal Glades. Their scales contain organic compounds adapted to damp, harsh conditions. Johaan wants to add those slick, resilient scales to his developing brew, hoping they will strengthen the Royal Apothecary Society's new plague and help it endure in the wild.

faq.q: What is the goal of Apothecary Johaan's research?
faq.answer: Apothecary Johaan is developing a new plague for the Royal Apothecary Society and Lady Sylvanas. He aims to make a contagion that can spread across entire populations and lands, targeting both the living and the Scourge.

faq.q: Why does Johaan need murloc scales specifically?
faq.answer: Johaan needs Vile Fin scales because they contain biological compounds that may help his contagion survive in the wild and pass between hosts. His early brewing showed him that simple poisons lack the complexity needed to spread effectively.

faq.q: Where can the Vile Fin murlocs be found?
faq.answer: The Vile Fin murlocs live along the coasts of Tirisfal Glades, especially on the northern beaches by the Great Sea and along the western coast.

faq.q: Who does Apothecary Johaan answer to?
faq.answer: Apothecary Johaan is an operative of the Royal Apothecary Society, an alchemical guild headquartered in the Undercity that answers directly to Queen Sylvanas Windrunner.

faq.q: What is the next step in this quest chain?
faq.answer: After you bring the Vile Fin scales to Johaan, he continues refining the formula. He needs more biological components and eventually plans to test the newly brewed strain.

faq.q: Are the Forsaken concerned about using murloc parts?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society is pragmatic and amoral about its experiments. It harvests from local flora, fauna, or beasts whenever they yield the biochemical traits it needs.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you help Apothecary Johaan work on a deadly plague meant to protect your sovereign realm and destroy your foes.
As Horde, you share a war with the Scourge, and the Forsaken pursue their new plague as a weapon against them.
